findings.explanation: The client can terminate the agreement at any time with short notice, while your right to terminate is severely restricted, creating an unbalanced termination structure.
findings.suggested_change: Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon providing thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other Party.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I am looking forward to getting started. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a few adjustments to the relevant clause to ensure the terms work well for both of us:

- Regarding the clause stating that the client can terminate the agreement at any time with short notice while your right to terminate is restricted, this creates an unbalanced termination structure. I propose changing this so that either party may terminate the agreement upon providing thirty days' prior written notice to the other party.
- Regarding the clause outlining your indemnification obligations, this is broad and lacks a monetary cap, exposing you to potentially unlimited financial liability. I propose adding that the developer's total liability under the agreement shall be limited to the total fees actually paid by the client to the developer under the agreement.

Thank you for considering these updates. Please let me know if these changes work for you so we can finalize the paperwork.

Best regards,
